В пирамиде GR00T N1 видео людей лежит в: In the GR00T N1 pyramid, human video lies at the base. Does that mean the table of pre-training hours has more human video than robot recordings?
Да, основание всегда самое большое по ча: Yes, the base is always the largest in hours
Нет: записей роботов 3289 часов, видео л: No: there are 3,289 hours of robot recordings and 2,517 of human video; the base is wide because of the web data inside the vision-language model
Нет, видео людей в предобучение не входи: No, human video isn't part of pre-training
Пирамида — про количество данных вообще: The pyramid is about the amount of data in general and about closeness to the robot. Web data isn't in Table 7: the model got it along with Eagle-2. GR-1's own recordings are 88 hours, about 1%.

На столе Ады смесь со своим выходом для: On Ada's table, the mix with a separate output for video gave 70%, and with a shared one, 54%. The model trained on video alone in the robot output got 3%: that output never saw robot actions.
Бюджет ограничен. Тратить его целиком на: The budget is limited. Is spending all of it on demonstrations of your own robot the best plan, since they are the most accurate?
Нет: при равном бюджете смесь с симуляци: No: with an equal budget, a mix with simulation wins, since there are few demonstrations and they come from few places
Нет, демонстрации робота не нужны вовсе: No, robot demonstrations aren't needed at all
На столе Ады 32 демонстрации в четырёх д: On Ada's table, 32 demonstrations in four homes gave 48%, and a mix of 16 demonstrations, 400 simulation episodes and 400 human clips for the same price gave 70%. Without robot demonstrations, the model is worse too.
Чем больше источник, тем больший вес ему: Does a bigger source get a bigger weight in the mixture?
Да, вес равен доле часов: Yes, the weight equals its share of the hours
Нет: вес — доля пакета, её подбирают опы: No: the weight is a share of the batch chosen by experiment; small accurate sources are often sampled more often than their share
GR00T N1 на постобучении смешивает реаль: In post-training, GR00T N1 mixes real trajectories with generated ones 1 : 1, even though you can generate as many as you like. For π0.5, 97.6% of the first-phase examples are not target data, and yet without them the model is worse.
π0.5 без веб-данных в учебных домах спра: Without web data, π0.5 did almost as well in the mock homes. Does that mean it doesn't need web data?
Нет: без них робот заметно хуже справлял: No: without it, the robot did noticeably worse with objects of unfamiliar categories
Нет, без них модель вообще не обучается: No, without it the model doesn't train at all
Польза слоя видна на той проверке, где н: A layer's benefit shows up in the test that needs what the layer teaches. Without recordings of other robots, π0.5 was noticeably worse even in the mock homes.

Без разметки парк Ады вырос с 35 до 42%,: Without labeling, Ada's fleet rose from 35 to 42%, and with half of the failures labeled, to 74%. In RECAP, people judge the outcome, step in and reset the scene; the authors write that the system is not fully autonomous.
Вдвое больше роботов — маховик крутится: Twice as many robots: does the flywheel spin twice as fast?
Да, данных вдвое больше: Yes, there's twice as much data

Парк из 32 роботов к четвёртой смене при: By the fourth shift, a fleet of 32 robots reached the same success as a fleet of 16: 74%. The flywheel grows when the robots get into new conditions and the model can absorb them.
